notes: Fixes: a player joining someone else's match now spawns when anyone picked Goku, Cape or Lara (rows 7-9); the kill cam no longer crashes the game when a bot merc kills a spy; every skin is selectable from the start and the 4th merc skin (FBI HRT) is shown. Everything else as x5: new skins (Goku, Lara, the tactical set, Cape), the in-lobby skin switch, GamBox's spawn-protection fix, the smoke-mine run-out fix. Everyone in a match needs this build.
